why: The shipped wordmark is an opaque 317x65 crop of ByteDance's launch thumbnail: white type over a photographic pink/blue gradient. Pasting it on the shorts factory's cream board puts a photograph inside the GRAPHIC CHART (cream ground, near-black ink, one terracotta accent, no gradients, no photographs).
transform: Alpha = whiteness of the source pixel (min-channel ramp 212..248 gated by saturation < 0.15); connected components under 60 px dropped as photographic ghosting; surviving alpha re-inked to #141416. Letterforms and geometry untouched: no redraw, no reflow, no resize, no re-typesetting. The '2.0' pill inverts with the rest, so the numerals read cream out of an ink pill exactly as they read black out of a white pill in the source.
precedent: claude-cowork (a mark recoloured along its own luminance ramp with geometry and alpha untouched, registered as a derived variant).
license_notes: ByteDance/Seedance brand artwork. Derivation for on-brand placement only; trademark remains with ByteDance.
